specification.selection_scope: Chosen after the fixed richer-flop matrix retained a six-chip250/delay125 miss (NashConv0.0116322490163). Freeze all four checkpoints before higher-iteration training. Preflight both legacy and opt-in admission for all checkpoints before any training. Require exact250-sweep serialized policy/physical/scalar parity between admissions, then independently replay every opt-in result over original physical worlds. Keep unchanged0.005 target, all misses and all cap rejections. No early stop, action/world reduction, speedup or memory claim.
specification.model_limits: Finite conditioned heads-up preflop/flop game with two narrow ranges/two selected flops, complete ordered future candidates and forced future checkdown. New opt-in admission explicitly replaces the legacyworlds*requested-iterations proxy with max300000physicalrows plus separately bounded full-requested-iteration vector work. Every other guard remains. No RSS bound, broad-range/full-deck, all-streets, multiway, unrestricted solver or general convergence guarantee.

No shared postflop/turn/river kernels, Coach, third-party source/dependencies or proprietary output.
